changelog.title: Cloud Sync Infrastructure
changelog.description: New Firestore integration for cloud-based user profiles, progress tracking, and cross-device sync.

changelog.title: Callsign System
changelog.description: Choose your unique callsign (@SHADOW_42) as your identity across Hexworth Prime. Random suggestions included.

changelog.title: Real Leaderboards
changelog.description: Live global and house-specific leaderboards showing actual user rankings by XP and level.

changelog.title: Progress Migration
changelog.description: Existing localStorage progress automatically migrates to cloud on sign-in. No progress lost.

changelog.title: Founding Member Status
changelog.description: Early users are marked as Founding Members with special tier badge on leaderboards.
